title: Chapter 282
text:
One.

After sending away the Overmera messenger, Han Xiao went to find Mad Blade and the others to experiment with the dungeon creation function.

Personal test subjects were indeed useful.

When he came to the next room, the four of them were not at home. Han Xiao scratched his head, took out his tablet, and opened all the hidden surveillance cameras in the sanctuary. The system filtered the faces and quickly locked onto the location of the four people. Maple Moon was learning the new formula from Yi Yeqing. The green fog was rolling out of the potion, and there were a few honest-looking players standing next to her. They were probably there to test the potion. They did not know what they were going to face next …

Hao Tian was in the arena … no, defending. As a professional guru, he had high expectations of himself and did not forget to train his skills at all times.

Mad Blade was being beaten up like a punching bag by Hella. Hella listened to Han Xiao's suggestion and found an Inhuman to be her training partner. She developed her superpower and beat up Mad Blade in all kinds of ways. Aurora was sitting in a wheelchair, hugging Bear Cub and watching from the side. Pork Bun was recording excitedly. He was more familiar with Mad Blade, so he was very happy to see Mad Blade being beaten into a pulp. Maybe this was what friends were like.

Han Xiao went to Hella's room and called the other four people to gather.

Just as he entered the yard, a black shadow flew over his head. It was Mad Blade, so without thinking, he reached out and pulled him down from the sky.

Hila retracted her hand, and her floating red hair fell back down, returning to its curly waist-length hair. The red light in her eyes disappeared, and Han Xiao sized up Frenzied Sword, who looked miserable. He nodded to himself. Now, Hila had the style of persuading his sister to leave.

The bear cub on Aurora's knee struggled to get up, fell to the ground, and rolled around. It ran to Han Xiao's side, hugged his leg, and climbed up. It hung around his neck like a backpack. The bear cub was fed well, and its weight had increased by almost two times.

Han Xiao raised his hand and slapped Bear Cub away. He then looked at the combat information on the interface. Bear Cub was level 18, four levels higher than when it was first brought back. It was a Claw Ice Bear species with good growth potential.

Hila's expression was complicated. She was full of hatred for the Germinal Organization, but she had never thought that such a huge organization would be completely destroyed. The hatred and hatred disappeared with the explosion. She could not help but think of the first time they met. Who would have thought that the pale and weak test subject would become such a legend a year later?

Seeing her expression, Han Xiao took out his tablet, opened a few photos and passed them to Hella. The photos were taken by the Six Nations' drones. The Germinal Organization's headquarters was in ruins after the nuclear explosion.

"After the explosion, most of them are dead. If the Germinal Organization still has people left, they will only be small fries in the periphery. So, there is no need to worry about the Germinal Organization coming back, unless they are tired of living." Han Xiao paused and said, "You were once a member of the Germinal Organization, and you are also on the Six Nations' wanted list. But now, you are one of my people. The Six Nations will not target you anymore."

Hella frowned. "I didn't say that I want to be your subordinate."

Aurora raised her hand. "I want to be."

Hella was bitter. She reached out and ruffled Aurora's hair. Aurora's hair had grown out during this time, and her short blonde hair covered her ears.

They chatted for a while, and Hao Tian and Maple Moon arrived. Usually, when Han Xiao summoned them, it would be good news, so they were secretly looking forward to it.

Han Xiao used the dungeon creation function. He thought for a while and intercepted the Dark Crow Valley operation to create a dungeon crystal. This level was suitable for the current players.

LV30 Dungeon Crystal – [Dark Crow Valley Operation]

Introduction: Dark Crow Valley Base, a base of the Germinal Organization in the Southern Continent, was destroyed by Stardragon and Hesla. This will be your test.

Dungeon Type: Backtracking Dungeon

Current Number of Players Cleared: 0

Highest Dungeon Completion Rate: None

Record Holder: None

"Dungeon Crystal?" The four of them looked at each other.

The average level of players was around level 30, and they had started to come into contact with dungeons. So far, Blue Star had found 11 fixed dungeons, which were dungeons that could be obtained from a certain character through repeated missions. Basically, they were from various factions, and they were all small five-man dungeons.

A new dungeon meant a new opportunity. After the four of them completed the mission, a white diamond-shaped crystal appeared in their hands, and they could enter the dungeon as long as they crushed it.

Mad Blade immediately said, "This is a five-man dungeon. Let's pull one more person and see if we can get the first clear."

Because of Han Xiao, the four of them often played together, and they were all familiar with each other.

Hao Tian nodded. "Okay, I'll pull Yellow Sky Shall Stand from Sky Territory over."

No one had any objections. The four of them went to the square and waited for a while. Yellow Sky Shall Stand ran over with a happy face. Hao Tian was his idol, and he was very happy that his idol was bringing him to play.

The five of them formed a small team.

"Let's have a look at the dungeon first."

Mad Blade crushed the crystal, and a mist enveloped the five of them, and they disappeared in the crowded square.

…

The five of them were dazzled, and their surroundings turned into a dense forest. It was night, and they could not see their own fingers.

The Backtracking Dungeon allowed players to participate in the past events.

A notification appeared on the interface.

You are the soldiers of the Dark Crow Valley Base. Hesla and Stardragon are about to invade. Your mission is to protect the Dark Crow Valley Base as much as possible.

Countdown to Dungeon Preparation: 10 minutes

Dungeon Objective: Survive until the end of the mission. Reward: 15000 EXP

Optional Mission 1: Kill five Stardragon or Hesla agents. Reward: 30000 EXP

Optional Mission 2: Protect the base from leaking the truth. Reward: 45000 EXP

Optional Mission 3: Pan Kuang and Ji Jie survive in the end. Reward: 70000 EXP

Optional Mission 4: Defeat the Stardragon and Hesla forces. Reward: 110000 EXP

Dungeon Failure Condition: Annihilation

"What a great reward!" Yellow Sky Shall Stand was shocked. As a core member of the guild, he was very knowledgeable. Currently, the level 30 dungeons that the players had encountered only had two to three missions, and the total reward was only 70,000 to 80,000 EXP. This dungeon had five missions, and the rewards were so high!

Yellow Sky Shall Stand's face turned serious. "But the higher the reward, the higher the difficulty."

The other four of them looked at each other in confusion.

Erm, is that so?

They did not feel that Black Phantom's mission was difficult …

"We are different," Pork Bun said sincerely. He did not have the heart to correct Yellow Sky Shall Stand.

Mad Blade looked at the notification and said in surprise, "The dungeon will start in ten minutes, but we can move freely now. What does this mean?"

This was the first time that they had encountered a dungeon with a countdown, and they were confused.

In fact, only dungeons with higher difficulty would have a countdown, and the entry point would be a period of time before the event to allow the players to prepare. It was the same this time. The dungeon started when the Hesla agents were about to steal the information, and the players had a chance to stop them. If they changed the starting plot, the entire dungeon would be lowered from 'Hell' difficulty to 'Hard'. However, the interface did not mention this, and the players had to figure it out themselves.

In the future, when Han Xiao released this dungeon, the players in the sanctuary would have to suffer hundreds of times before they found the right way to start.

At this time, the five of them did not know the importance of these ten minutes, and they started the dungeon according to the rules. However, this was their first time exploring a dungeon, and this kind of compound dungeon was very different from the usual dungeons. The sense of immersion and gameplay were higher, and the difficulty was also higher. The five of them were in pain but happy at the same time, and they could only follow the mission given by the base and patrol continuously.

A day passed like this. On the second night, as a routine patrol, Bun-Hit-Dog's head suddenly exploded.

Your teammate [Pork Bun Beat the Dog] has died.

"What the hell?" The remaining four of them were shocked and quickly looked around. However, the forest was deep, and the night was dark. The wind blew and the leaves rustled, and they did not know where the enemy was.

Bang! This time, it was Hao Tian's turn to get a headshot. The three of them were very nervous.

Hao Tian's voice sounded in the team channel. "The interface says that I received a fatal attack. The one who killed me is Black Phantom!"

The three of them were shocked. So, this was a dungeon with Han Xiao in it! And in the enemy's camp!

Everyone's morale plummeted.

Han Xiao's dungeon generation function was to intercept an event and automatically generate a mission. The characters in the dungeon were all mirror images, and they acted according to the original plot. They had the strength of that time, but it had nothing to do with the original person.

Three consecutive gunshots, and the three of them were dead. Their vision blurred, and they returned to the square. They spent a day in the dungeon, but only ten minutes had passed in the outside world. The time flow in the dungeon was different.

Dungeon [Dark Crow Valley Operation] failed.

Dungeon cooldown time: 3 hours.

The five of them smiled bitterly.

This was too difficult. They did not even know how they died.

…

On the other hand, Han Xiao saw the return of the five of them from the monitor. After confirming that the dungeon crystal was effective, he started to think.

The dungeon crystal can only be issued through missions, and it cannot be sold for money. Its use to me is to gather more players and provide more benefits to the players. This way, it will be easier to command the players, and the players will know about my deeds through the dungeon, which will increase my status. These are all more hidden benefits. However, the dungeon crystal cannot be sold, so there is no direct benefit.
